about: Values Claude filled in for things your spreadsheet doesn't have yet (created 2026-10-06).
Nothing here overrides your spreadsheet: a value is only used when your sheet's cell is empty.
CAS numbers were checked against PubChem (link in casSource) and pass the CAS check digit.
Category and odorFamily come from Claude's general knowledge and were not checked against a reference.
Synonyms are only included when PubChem lists them for that CAS number.

IFRA limits ("ifra") are Category 4 (fine fragrance), researched 2026-10-06 from your suppliers' IFRA certificates (Fraterworks, PerfumersWorld) and IFRA's official Standards Library. 'value' is only used where your sheet's cell is empty; otherwise 'check' records what your value was compared with.
Usage rates, prices, sizes and suppliers are never filled in here.
